title: AezaCore
description: The core Azea plugin required to use any of the Azea ecosystems plugins
body:
The core plugin used by other Aeza plugins under the hood! Its needed to use any of the Aeza plugins and does not add anything to the server that the server or players can interact with.

Note that different versions of other Aeza plugins may require newer versions of AezaCore, to ensure full compatability please update all your Aeza plugins and AezaCore to the latest version when availble
